name: @taxa/react-e2e-harness
description: Isolated React E2E harness scaffold (PR 5c.2-B.1a; PR 5c.2-B.1b-i adds the capture CLI + Chromium runner). Pinned Next 16.3.3 + React 19.2.8 + Playwright 1.56.0; mounts FileExplorer from the live @taxa/research barrel against a synthetic taxon id + harness-only baseUrl env var. No app-shell, no production globals, no legacy web/* re-export.
